class Entity:
	def __init__(self, name: str):
		self.name = name

class Relation:
	def __init__(self, head_entity: Entity, tail_entity: Entity):
		self.head_entity = head_entity
		self.tail_entity = tail_entity

"Physical locations and spatial paths only. Exclude attire such as in a swimsuit, ownership, participation and figurative uses. The emitted relation class carries the qualifier. Copy subject/reference entity noun phrases, not leading spatial preposition phrases. Do not replace an unrepresented/unstated relation with At or infer a place from a typical activity. Condition scope: location of entity"

class At(Relation):

	Description: At a stated physical place or location. Not a fallback for a more specific qualifier.

	pass
